summary: Iter150C · Source Ledgers / Financial Traceability tested end-to-end. Backend: ran the two new pytest suites with -n0 → 39 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed (skips are legit: demo tenant has no wallet_transfer/wallet_adjustment legs in fin_txn yet, and test_12 is a documented environmental skip). Frontend: /fin/day-book renders with all required data-testids (page, date-from/to, source-type, account-code, totals, table); 2662 legs rendered with 2662 per-row Drill buttons; 8 per-account Ledger links present. Drill modal opens with source-drill-dialog + source-drill-doc + source-drill-legs + source-drill-close; JSON of the authoritative invoice source doc plus its projected legs (DR/CR + totals Dr ₹30k · Cr ₹30k · Net ₹0.00) render correctly. Clicking fin-account-link-EXPENSE_DEFAULT navigated to /fin/accounts/EXPENSE_DEFAULT?date_from=2026-08-13&date_to=2026-09-12 preserving date range. /fin/accounts/BANK_DEFAULT renders with ledger-page, date-from/to, summary (Debits ₹4.90L · Credits 0 · Net ₹4.90L · 84 legs), table with running balance column, and 84 drill buttons; drill dialog opens correctly. No page errors, no unexpected console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Account Ledger drill button triggered a single 404 response for one leg — this is expected behaviour for cascade/payment legs whose source_id is a composite key (e.g. {inv_id}:idx0) where the direct source-lookup returns 404 but the leg still renders. Consider whether to render a 'deleted/composite' badge inline instead of firing the 404 to the network tab.
Day Book renders 2662 drill buttons for a 30-day range — no pagination or virtualisation. Fine for the demo tenant but will degrade on real tenants. Out of Iter150C scope but worth tracking.
test_credentials: DEMO_TOKEN_VALUE from backend/.env, injected into localStorage.session_token
seed_data_creation: None (read-only iter). Pytest suites create their own transient wallet docs and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter150C is fully READ/UI-only and behaves correctly. The 3 skipped tests will convert to passing automatically once demo tenant grows wallet_transfer/wallet_adjustment fin_txn legs. Always run these two files with -n0 to avoid the documented motor/xdist loop flake.
